race.description: Lexus Of Central West Luxury Showcase Hcp (C1)
race.comment: TIGLETTA (2) jumped sharply in grade first up with an even fifth in the small field over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Back in his right class and ticks plenty of boxes from the draw. MIDNIGHT IN MINORI (9) holding her form and looks up to this stronger race after finishing second over 1400m at Geurie. Well drawn with the key jockey change. WOOTTEN IT BE NICE (1) finds an easier race today after tiring late when fifth over 1280m at Muswellbrook in BM66 class. Now in the Todd Smith stable and can overcome the poor draw. SILVER AGENT (12) better effort last start when he finished third over 1100m at Wellington on September 15 and has minor place prospects.
